name: @neus/mcp-server
description: Portable trust harness for AI. Identity, proofs, permissions, and private context in any MCP client.
author: NEUS Network <dev@neus.network>

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('server.json','utf8'));if(p.version!==s.version)throw new Error('package.json and server.json version mismatch: '+p.version+' vs '+s.version);if(p.description!==s.description)throw new Error('package.json and server.json descriptions must match');if(String(s.description||'').length>100)throw new Error('server.json description must be <=100 chars for MCP Registry (got '+String(s.description).length+')');if(s.repository?.subfolder!=='mcp/npm-dist')throw new Error('server.json repository.subfolder must be mcp/npm-dist');if(!p.files.includes('LICENSE')||!fs.existsSync('LICENSE'))throw new Error('Apache-2.0 LICENSE must be published');"
